name: IceCon
blurb: A small, biennial fan convention in Reykjavik covering science fiction, fantasy and horror, running since 2016.
notes: IceCon runs every other year. The most recent edition ran May 29-31, 2026 (homepage text: 'Fantasy, Sci-Fi and Horror Fan Convention | Reykjavík | Iceland May 29th - 31th, 2026'), which already ended before the research window (2026-10-05). The homepage states 2026 is 'our 10th anniversary and our 5th con' since 2016, confirming the biennial cadence, so the next edition would fall in 2028 - after the window end (2027-12-31) - and is not listed. The seed URL (icecon-reykjavik.is/en/) 404'd; used the site root instead, which works.
